description: This file defines a Java data transfer object (DTO) class named FundTransferRequest used in the fund transfer service of an internet banking application. It encapsulates the details required for a fund transfer operation, including source and destination account identifiers, transfer amount, and authentication ID.

classes.name: FundTransferRequest
classes.description: A data transfer object class representing the request details for transferring funds between accounts. It utilizes Lombok to generate boilerplate code for getters, setters, and other utility methods.
